questions.text: Can you reach people who bought before?

answers.text: Yes, they follow me or joined my list

questions.text: How often do you have something new?

tests.do: Show your newest {top_group} to past buyers with a small thank-you for returning.
tests.success: {target_orders} orders from past buyers within 14 days

tests.do: Put a small card in every order inviting buyers to follow you for new pieces.
tests.success: Half of this month's buyers can be reached again

tests.do: Send a reminder for the {n_unpaid} invoices unpaid for 14 days or more.

questions.text: Why do people send back this item?

tests.do: Ask the next 3 people who send it back what was wrong.

questions.text: Could your cheapest items sell as a set?

tests.do: Offer the cheapest item as a set of two at a small discount.
